params.name: Mayfly 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/mayfly-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Mayfly fifty years on, after the Opener BlackFly and the Pivotal Helix: a single-seat electric tilt-wing ultralight. A teardrop pod under one bubble canopy that tilts forward on its bow, a tail swept up into the aft wing, a low forward wing with full-span elevators and a high aft wing on a pylon with flaps, ailerons and twin endplate fins with rudders; four motors with five-blade props on each wing, both wings on tilt hinges at their roots (drawn in cruise); battery bays down the flanks, a charge port, a ballistic parachute hatch, a lidar nose and chin cameras; tricycle gear in pants, as the 172 had. A variant of the ultralight mesh, worn as the Mayfly 2076 factory edition.
